values_mathematically_equal.meaning: the two compared floating point values are mathematically equal though their bit representations differ

equal_exponents_branch_reached.meaning: comparison reaches the main comparison logic branch where the two numbers have equal exponents

le_result.meaning: the boolean result returned by le(a,b) for the compared operands

not_gt_result.meaning: the boolean value !(a > b) computed from gt() for the same operands

assumptions: le() and gt() are invoked on the same pair of operands in the same comparison context.
The reported inconsistency concerns the boolean return values of le() and gt(), not a revert or exception.

unresolved.description: Report does not state concrete operand values or which operand order yields which result, so the exact per-order outcome cannot be bound.

limitations: Formalizes only the le()/gt() logical-consistency relation for the target impact; other listed impacts are not covered by this plan.
The equality of le_result and not_gt_result is asserted as the desired correspondence; code-level binding of the flawed equal-exponent branch is deferred.
